Author: Anurag Duddu
Message:
feat(byok): Phase 0 foundation for balance visibility feature (#3)

* docs: add Hobby-plan scaling implementation plan

Bite-sized, TDD-style, checkbox-tracked plan for executing the
2026-04-06-methodex-hobby-scaling design. Five workstreams:

- WS1 (T6): Railway deploy-wait step in GitHub Actions
- WS2 (T4): memory trim + llm_service naming/docstring cleanup
- WS3 (T1): Celery chain refactor replacing monolithic
  analyze_video_task/analyze_project_task
- WS4 (T2+T5): beat extraction, multi-replica topology,
  /health/ready endpoint, DB pool resize, Redis maxmemory
- WS5: production smoke + burst load validation

Wave 1 (WS1, WS2, WS3) runs in parallel worktrees; WS2 rebases
on WS3. Wave 2 (WS4) lands after Wave 1 soak. Wave 3 (WS5)
validates the complete topology.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

* feat(byok): Phase 0 foundation for balance visibility feature

Ground-truths the OpenRouter balance-endpoint contract and establishes
the shared types/constants that Worktrees A (backend), B (gates), and
C (frontend UX) will all build against in parallel.

- Split ERROR_TYPE_INSUFFICIENT_CREDITS (402) out of ERROR_TYPE_LLM_PERMANENT
  so the frontend can render a dedicated "Add credits" CTA instead of a
  generic permanent-error banner. Both types remain non-retryable, so the
  fail-fast behavior from the prior session's 402 fix is preserved.
- Extend the frontend parseError.ts union with llm_permanent (pre-existing
  bug: backend has been emitting it since last session, but the TS union
  never caught up) and insufficient_credits, plus getErrorTypeLabel cases.
- Add backend/scripts/openrouter_balance_spike.py + a gated integration
  test (@pytest.mark.skipif OPENROUTER_LIVE_API_KEY) that verifies the
  /auth/key, /key, and /credits endpoint shapes against the real API.
  Contract locked via the integration test so downstream worktrees can
  depend on it.
- Add docs/byok-balance-contract.md spelling out the BalanceInfo shape,
  DB columns, REST endpoints, 402 response, and error-flow diagram. This
  is the single source of truth Worktrees A/B/C code against.

Key finding from the spike: /api/v1/credits works with regular keys
(not just management keys as some third-party docs claim) and is the
only way to get a real balance for pay-as-you-go accounts where
/auth/key returns limit=null. Our BalanceInfo will call BOTH endpoints
and merge: /credits for the spendable number, /auth/key for metadata
(is_free_tier, label, per-key cap).

Tests:
- backend/tests/test_error_classification.py — 36 passed (adds 402-split
  coverage, 422 coverage, llm_permanent non-retryable assertions)
- backend/tests/test_analysis_step_non_retryable.py — 9 passed (adds
  insufficient_credits regression test)
- backend/tests/test_openrouter_integration.py — 10 passed live against
  real OpenRouter, skipped cleanly when OPENROUTER_LIVE_API_KEY unset
- frontend/src/lib/parseError.test.ts — 34 passed (adds backend contract
  round-trip tests for llm_permanent and insufficient_credits)
- Full backend suite (467 tests) green

Note: there is pre-existing uncommitted frontend refactor work in the
tree that is NOT part of this commit (touching ~90 files). This commit
intentionally cherry-picks only the Phase 0 foundation files.

Refs: /Users/idstuart/.claude/plans/abstract-spinning-mountain.md

Author: Anurag Duddu
Message:
feat(settings): rebuild Model Settings dialog around explicit Standard/Premium mode toggle (#11)

* docs(settings): add Model Settings redesign spec + implementation plan

Spec describes the rebuild around an explicit Standard / Premium mode
toggle, the split of PUT /settings into POST /settings/api-key and
PUT /settings/preferred-model, and the elimination of selectedModel
local-state mirroring that causes the visible UI desync bugs.

Plan is a 12-task TDD implementation guide. Branch from origin/main.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

* feat(settings): add request schemas for split api-key + preferred-model endpoints

* style(settings): align new schema validator with existing UserSettingsUpdate

* feat(settings): add POST /settings/api-key with save-time balance check

Adds a single-purpose endpoint for adding/replacing a BYOK API key.
Validates against OpenRouter and rejects $0-credit keys before persisting.
Does not touch preferred_model (that's Task 3). Includes a db_user_factory
fixture in the new test file for per-test user seeding via the app's DB override.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(settings): align POST /settings/api-key error handling with PUT pattern

* feat(settings): add PUT /settings/preferred-model with tier enforcement

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(settings): DELETE /api-key resets preferred_model to DEFAULT_STANDARD_MODEL

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* refactor(settings): remove combined PUT /settings + UserSettingsUpdate schema

Deletes the obsolete `update_user_settings` route and `UserSettingsUpdate`
schema now that Task 2 (POST /settings/api-key) and Task 3
(PUT /settings/preferred-model) provide clean split replacements.

- Removed `@router.put("/settings", ...)` and `UserSettingsUpdate` entirely
- Removed `UserSettingsUpdate` import from users.py; all other imports
  (fetch_balance_sync, OpenRouterBalanceError, encryption_service) remain —
  they are still used by add_api_key and refresh_balance
- test_users_balance_routes.py: deleted 4 tests that exclusively exercised
  PUT /settings; migrated 5 setup calls (key seeding) from PUT /settings
  to POST /settings/api-key so the balance/refresh/delete tests still work
- test_input_edge_cases.py: migrated 2 format-validation tests from
  PUT /settings to PUT /settings/preferred-model (real subject: schema
  validation, not the old combined endpoint)
- test_validation_security.py: migrated TestPreferredModelValidation from
  UserSettingsUpdate to PreferredModelUpdateRequest; removed test_none_model_accepted
  (tested Optional behavior unique to old schema)
- test_schemas_validators.py: migrated TestUserSettingsSchemas to
  TestApiKeyAddRequestSchemas using ApiKeyAddRequest; removed
  test_none_api_key_accepted (tested Optional behavior unique to old schema)

Result: 573 passed, 10 skipped (live integration tests)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* docs(tests): refresh stale fixture docstring after PUT /settings removal

* feat(settings): split service into addApiKey + updatePreferredModel

Replace the combined updateSettings/UserSettingsUpdate with two
single-purpose methods: addApiKey (POST /api/users/settings/api-key)
and updatePreferredModel (PUT /api/users/settings/preferred-model).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

* feat(settings): split useSettings into addApiKey + updatePreferredModel mutations

Removes the combined updateSettings/isUpdating/updateError/resetUpdateError
surface and replaces it with two focused mutations (addApiKey, updatePreferredModel),
each with their own error/reset/pending state. Exposed via mutateAsync so callers
can await them. Preserves refreshBalance, deleteApiKey, and recommendedQuery exports.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* feat(settings): rewrite ModelSettingsDialog around mode toggle + sticky pendingModel

Replaces the single combined-form dialog with a Tabs-driven Standard/Premium
mode selector. The dialog now derives mode once per open from the saved
preferred_model, holds only `mode`, `apiKeyDraft`, and a sticky `pendingModel`
in local state, and commits the model selection separately from BYOK
key validation. Background ["user-settings"] refetches no longer clobber
in-flight model picks (ref-guarded init effect).

Tests rewritten as TDD against the new flow: 14 scenarios across mode init,
Standard mode, Premium-no-key, Premium-validated, and refetch stickiness.
Uses vi.spyOn(settingsService, ...) so the real useSettings hook + mutations
flow through a per-test QueryClient.

* fix(settings): surface model save errors in Standard mode + no-credits CTA

- Render updateModelErrorMessage inline in Standard tab (above key-on-file affordance) so updatePreferredModel failures are never silently swallowed in Standard mode
- Add "Add credits on OpenRouter" link in addKeyErrorMessage block when error contains "$0 credits", pointing to openrouter.ai/settings/credits
- Add test: no-credits 400 renders inline error and exposes the credits link (spec plan #12)
- Add test: switching tabs clears pendingModel, disabling Save; switching back shows original saved model (spec plan #18)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* polish(settings): shared error helper, robust credits CTA, delete-key errors, reopen test

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(settings): defensive optional-chaining for partial settings shapes
